label: two charges at Claywater
intent: hook: travellers pay at both banks for one stop, and some now wade at night below the raft, where the crocodile lies; she wants one charge; sends the player to Livia Varinius at the well and Signs-For-The-Cargo at the raft

label: two charges at Claywater
intent: the station's side: two drakes a traveller for the stop and its water, to pay a mason to re-line the well in stone, since the landing would not haul stone; she takes the two drakes from the player (takeGold 2) or names the price; the landing's charge is on walkers who wade a ford anyone can wade, and she has never charged the landing for water

label: two charges at Claywater
intent: the landing's side, priced by the wheel: a drake a head to wade, more by the wheel for a cart; he takes the drake from the player (takeGold 1) or names it; the ford was worked before the well; the landing does not drink the well's water or haul stone for it; he set the walkers' charge when the station set its charge

label: the landing's terms
intent: what the landing would give: no stone ever, but the landing's way with any wall on this bank, clay pressed in behind it, which moves with the bank where stone cracks; there is no clay, because the crocodile has the bend, and the rains are seven days off

label: the landing's terms
intent: her objection: mud has no place in an Imperial well; the landing would take half a charge for water it never draws

label: the failing well
intent: at disposition 30 or more: the well water tastes of the ford now, so the ford is getting in; clay holds where stone cracks; she thinks the landing's charge is wrong and sends the waders to the bend (the line sets flag.lf83.ford-tasted). Below 30: she will not talk against her neighbours to a stranger, and says so

label: the failing well
intent: until the player knows the crack (no flag.lf83.ford-tasted, no jar, no ledger page): the water is only low after a dry season. Once the player knows it: she admits the new crack, that the stone has cracked before and that she has re-mortared it every dry season

label: the clay bend
intent: the landing digs its plaster clay at the bend below the raft; a crocodile has the deep water under it and comes up at anyone on the cut; nobody has dug for ten days; once the crocodile is dead he admits he dropped the basket and ran

label: the clay bend
intent: the waders cross at the bend at night, where the crocodile lies; their prints are in the clay at dawn

label: one charge for the stop
intent: the settlement: one charge for the stop, split between the banks, the landing's clay pressed in behind the head. She agrees (the line sets flag.lf83.one-charge-station) once the player knows the crack and has heard the landing's terms from Signs-For-The-Cargo; before then she gives her open objection

label: one charge for the stop
intent: the settlement as the landing hears it. He agrees once the crocodile is dead and he is given the clay basket (the line takes item.lf83.clay-basket and sets flag.lf83.one-charge-landing); before then: there is no clay to give

label: the ford charge
intent: the obvious option: for a hundred drakes he takes no charge from walkers this season; with the gold the agreeing line takes it and sets flag.lf83.ford-charge-bought; without it he names the price

label: the station's charge
intent: back the landing: once the player knows the crack, she drops her charge on the stop rather than have travellers hear the stone has failed (sets flag.lf83.stop-charge-dropped), and keeps the well as it is; before then she defends the charge

label: latest rumours
intent: hook: guests are falling sick and people blame his food; below 40 he keeps his thoughts from strangers and says so

label: sickness at the spring
intent: he thinks something is in the spring, not his pot; only Im-Moro may go into the pool; ask her, or test the water

label: sickness at the spring
intent: it is the travellers' food; shown the test or the sick guests she grants the player leave to go in, once

label: the body in the spring
intent: she has seen it now; she will have it raised once the killer is named

label: the body in the spring
intent: at first the courier left without paying; shown the rope or the body he admits the pack is in his store

label: the body in the spring
intent: a stake carries the dead person's story; a blank one means the killer knew the custom and chose not to honour the dead

label: the body in the spring
intent: friendly and helpful; blames the fire stand's food and points at Tsono-Ra

label: what the households said
intent: he knows his knot; at first evasive; at disposition 40 or shown the rope he admits selling it late to Reeh-Shaal

label: accuse
intent: available with two exhibits (shapeData.accusation); she breaks and admits it, naming the packet

label: accuse
intent: the wrong accusation: he is shamed and says nothing more

label: the sick root
intent: the Conclave's commission: the Hist is sickening, the village blames the salt works; he stopped buying their salt a year ago

label: the sick root
intent: the salt works foul her spring; nothing of Greenspring's does

label: the sick root
intent: the leaves and the sap; he will not guess the cause

label: the cut in the roots
intent: shown the tool-marks he reads the founders' stakes aloud and names the dead grove

label: the cut in the roots
intent: the Conclave must hear it; he offers to pay for the sealing if the founders stay unnamed
